name: Dave Shapiro
line: Booking agent for Let's Get It at The Agency Group, later a co-founder of Sound Talent Group. He died on 22 May 2025 in a plane crash in San Diego.

name: Daniel Williams
line: Founding drummer of The Devil Wears Prada (2005 to 2016), and a friend and early supporter of Let's Get It. He died on 22 May 2025 in the same crash, aged 39.
